tier3_constraints.constraint_text: All patient data must be encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.3). Access must follow role-based access control with audit logging of all PHI access per HIPAA requirements.
tier3_constraints.reasoning: Explicit requirements for encryption (confidentiality), access control (authentication), and audit logging (non-repudiation) are core security concerns per ISO 25010.

tier3_constraints.constraint_text: The system must maintain 99.95% uptime with automatic failover. Planned maintenance windows shall not exceed 4 hours per month.
tier3_constraints.reasoning: Explicit availability requirement (99.95% uptime), fault tolerance (automatic failover), and recoverability constraints are core reliability concerns per ISO 25010.

tier3_constraints.constraint_text: The system must support HL7 FHIR R4 APIs for data exchange with external laboratories, pharmacies, and insurance providers. Legacy HL7 v2 interfaces must be maintained for existing integrations.
tier3_constraints.reasoning: Explicit interoperability requirements with external systems using HL7 FHIR R4 and HL7 v2 standards for data exchange qualify as compatibility concerns.

tier3_constraints.constraint_text: Clinical note retrieval must complete within 2 seconds. The system must support 5000 concurrent users across all facilities during peak hours.
tier3_constraints.reasoning: Explicit time behaviour constraint (2 seconds retrieval) and capacity requirement (5000 concurrent users) are core performance concerns per ISO 25010.

tier3_constraints.constraint_text: The interface must be accessible to clinical staff with varying technical proficiency. Mobile access must be available for rounding physicians.
tier3_constraints.reasoning: Requirements for accessibility to users with varying technical proficiency and mobile access address learnability, operability, and accessibility concerns per ISO 25010.

tier3_constraints.constraint_text: The system must comply with HIPAA regulations and support HL7 FHIR interoperability standards.
tier3_constraints.reasoning: HIPAA regulatory compliance is an ethical and compliance concern that spans multiple quality attributes and requires oversight for legal adherence.
